subject: general
question:
The following bar graph shows the sales of books (in thousands) from six branches of a publishing company during two consecutive years 2018 and 2019.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/330a46a74149b9801680f03d700b615c241e67d7875f88510aff9b48ce1f7241.png] 

What is the ratio of the total sales of the first branch for both years to the total sales of the fourth branch for both years?
solution:
Calculation:

The total sales of the first branch for both years = 80 + 105 = 185 thousand

The total sales of the fourth branch for both years = 85 + 95 = 180 thousand

Now, the ratio = 185 : 180 = 37 : 36

**∴ The ratio of the total sales of the first branch for both years to the total sales of the fourth branch for both years is 37 : 36.**
